tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'bam bcos tshe 'dzin srog skyob bzhugs so//

sman bla drang srong bla ma dang*// lhag pa'i lha la gus btud nas// 'bam bcos tshe 'dzin srog skyob 'di// kho bos sbyin no dga' bas longs// 'di la rgyu dang brtag thabs dang*// bcos dang rjes gcod rnam pa bzhi// dang po rgyu la ring dang nye// ring ba ma rig la sogs pa| |bag chags goms shas che ba rnams// 'phral rkyen ngan pa sad las byung*// nye ba lus gnas chu ser khrag /bad kan gsum 'dus rgyu yin la| |rul sungs rjen 'chang mngar skyur zas// snum lci brtan dbyung mi 'phrod chu// chang rgan gyis bskyed spyod lam yang*// dal 'dug nyin gnyid chu brgal dang*// rlan grang glo bur drag shul spyod// brdabs sogs mi mkhas spyod las 'byung*// dus ni dgun smad dpyid sogs ldang*// gdon ni grib dang shing gnyan bcad// sa rko rdo slog chu gnyan dkrugs// klu dang sa bdag btsan rgyal po// khros pas bskyed pa'i nad du bshad// dbye ba rlung bad mkhris gsum las// khrag gnyan bsdongs pa'i 'bam rigs ni// dkar nag khra bor ming du btags// gnyis pa de zhugs rtags bstan pa// spyi dang bye brag khyad par gsum// spyi rtags rlung gyur rtsub pa la// skrangs po mdog nag sob cing sbo/ */mkhris gyur tsha la mdog ser ba// bad kan lci zhing zug chung ste// kun kyang na zhing skrangs po mtho// gnyis pa bye brag rtags bstan pa// rtsa shed chung dal chu mdog dwangs// skrangs skya sob la spu sgo byi// reg bya grang zhing skrangs po nyab// rjes lan ba spu gyen la lang*// zug chung khol bur tsha ba dang*// nywa 'khyug rlung gyur 'bam dkar po// rtsa rgyus phra spun chu dmar smug |ku ya lang long mtshal zhag can// skrangs dmar nag gam sngo ba dang*// zug che khrag 'brum thon pa dang*// me lce'i dbyibs 'dra drod 'bar ba// khrag mkhris las gyur 'bam nag yin| |rtags 'dres rkang rus mi bzod gzer// skrangs po me ri sngo ba la// je nag 'gro zhing na ba dag

/khrag bor mkhas pas tha snyad btags// yang na bad rlung shas che ba// grang 'bam zhes bya dkar po ste// khrag mkhris che ba tsha 'bam nag /de gnyis 'dres pa khra bor brjod// bab yul stod la'ang 'bam nag nyid// skrang zug dang bcas 'byung ba'ang srid// 'bam nad phal cher chu ser dang*// chu so ro smad khrag 'dzag srid// gzhan yang pags la bab na ni// ba spu lang zhing pags mdog 'gyur// shar bab skrang mtho na zug che// rtsa dang chu rgyus la bab na// 'khums shing brkyang bskum khag pa 'byung*// khar bab so dang mgul pa na// da ni 'tsho dang mi 'tsho dang*// mdog nag shed chung bab lji ba| |rkang la bab rtags 'tsho mi 'gyur// rkang lag sul dang chu rgyus la// 'phrig 'khyug bcos kyang skyed med pa// mas rim 'dzeg pa ltar byed pa'ang*// mi 'tsho yang gcig byang khog dang*| |pho ba rgyu long 'khrugs shing na// lte bar bab pas lnga par 'gyur// thigs nag ces bya khams 'dzag pa// nges par gshin rjes 'khrid par nges// lo gcig lon pa'ang gso bar dka'| |gsum pa khyad par brtag pa'i thabs// dang po skrangs po gang byung steng*// dpa' bo lca sga rab sbyar ba'i// rtsi mar byugs pa nyi mas bsregs// ngor lang gdug rtsub ston na 'bam| |phan par gyur na chu ser rlung*// skya rbab sogs yin nad gzhan la// btang snyoms byed pa myong ba'i gnad// 'di la blun po la la dag /khrag dang gnyan 'brum reg dug dang*| |sa gdon sogs zer 'khrul rlom gyi// skye bo'i srog 'phrog byed pa yin// sman pa gshin rje'i pho nya 'gas// sa steng gang ba ma mthong ngam// gsum pa de dag bcos pa'i thabs| |kha zas rim 'gro sman gsum las// dang po zas bcos tshwa sdor dang*// spangs pa'i phye thug zan la phug /mdzo mo'i zho smin rkang thung bcud// bsten zhing rul sungs sngo rjen spang*| |nad 'go chog nas sre long dang*// skam sangs thug pa gtang bar bya// dkar po'i rigs la phye thug dang*// lug zho mar gsar bcud bsten zhing*// nad 'go chog nas lus gso'i skabs// smyo byed sbrang dkar sogs bsten zhing*// gnyan tshogs 'bri g.yag nywa bzhi'i sha// thug pa tshwa med bsten bya zhing*// de nas rim gyis cha yis glod// phal cher rig pa'i mda' dang sbyar// gnyis pa zhi byed sman la yang*// thang byug 'byar dang ril bu dang*// sbyong byed dag dang rnam pa lnga// dang po zhi byed thang gi sde// 'bras gsum tig ta gser me tog

|bong dkar se 'bru brag zhun dang*// dug nyung bse yab ma nu rnams// bskol grang tho rangs bsten par bya// yang na seng sdeng a ru ra// chu ser sman gsum kyi lce dkar// sgron shing bcas pa'i thang yang mchog /sdud byed 'bras gsum tho rangs gtang*// so so'i zhi byed bad kan la// pi ling a ru'i thang sbyin zhing*// rlung la e ran rta yi mar// 'bras chang lca sga 'o mar sbyar// blud cing mkhris khrag tsha 'bam la// a skyur zho bzhi ba ru gang*// rus dbyung ba sha sle tres dang*// seng ldeng tig ta tsandan dkar| |se 'bru spos dkar gu gul dang*// dbang lag rnams ni zho re re// gla rtsi zhad tsam sbyar brdungs pa// thum po gser srang do yi 'bung*// mnyam pa snum med rdza nang du// chu bre phyed gsum dang sbyar ba// bskol grang thang ni 'bam nag po// ma dwangs bar du gung gnyis bsten// deng sang sman pa phal che bas// 'bam la zhi byed thang med ces// cal sgrog 'khrul bar 'khyam 'di ltos// dbye thang 'bras gsum kun la sbyar// gnyis pa byug pa dag la yang*// thog mar rang gi mi bskyod pas// bkru zhing ras dkar dag gis phyi// bul tog zhu mkhan cha mnyam la// chus sbyangs nad skrang khyab par byugs// gal te ma thul a lakta// gong gi gnyis kyi steng du bsnan// des kyang ma phan zab lag bsnan// bzhi sbrel gyis ni 'joms par nges// gal te gzhig par ma nus na// lci ba ser ka'i bi bhu ta// ri sho cha mnyam ba chus bran// blugs shing dkris pas 'joms par byed// gal te shin tu gzhom dka' na| |gsum pa 'byar gyis gzhom pa'i thabs// sngo rog mdzo lci wa li kā// bul dang sa zhag sbyar ba dag /ba dmar chus sbus skyo ma ni// ra lug spyi dkar gyis btums pa// dgos pa'i yul kun khyab par dkri// rlung 'bam skrangs po gzhom dka' ba// rdza'am long rdo'i dreg pa rnams// rdza nang brngos la su ras sbrus// tsha gdung ldan pa sbyar bas 'joms// des ma thub na mi rta khyi'i// rus zhun nang du spos dkar btab// sbyar zhing byugs pas nges par 'joms// des kyang ma thub byang lta'i ri'i// g.ya' rgan rul po zhib btags pa// sla ngar brngos la til mar sbrus// snur bas zho ltar gyur pa'i tshe// sbal rgyab mdung rtse bsnan sbyar bas// 'joms par nges so thub dka' na// cong zhi mer bsregs chang du bsgyur// khu ba brag zhun hong len sbyar// 'di ni 'byar lum yun bsrings na// 'bam rigs gsum gyi grong khyer rnams// mi gzhom mi srid zab par gdams// yang na dkar po chig thub ni// 'dul sbyong zhal shes ltar byas pa// sbyar bas 'bam rigs kun 'joms so// nad sel sman gyi sbyor ba ni// gzhon dar khrag dang tshad pa'i gzhi/

/che na sbyor ba 'di gces te// rdo rje nā ga nag po lhog pa zil pa stong ri can/ /rgyal po gnyis skyes spos ghidda dhū pe dri bsnam// 'bras bu dkar nag til zir bzhi btsun mo bzhi// 'dre 'jigs gu gul dri ldan kastu ri gnyer ma can/ shu dag /gser mdog ldan wi ra si ta gnyis har blon po'i tshul// rwa can dkar nag sdig pa rus pa'i ru rta// dbang po lag pa bcas pa rnams// rgyal po yab sras cha mnyam zhing*// btsun mo blon 'bangs de yi phyed// so sor btags la chu dron sbrus// 'dam thag ba ril tshad du bsgril// nyi mas ma reg bskam par bya| |yang na phye ma byas kyang rung*// chu bskol gyis phul gung gnyis gtang*// mang nyung nad tshabs dang bstun zhing*// mal gos dro zhing rngul dbyung bas// 'bam gyi tshogs rnams brlag par byed// rgan po grang ba rlung che na/ /'gugs byed sngo rgyal po chen po la// shing tsandan gnyis gser mdzod gnyis gi waṃ kuṅku ma btsun mo gla rtsi// rdo rje gnyis klu ni blon po'i thal tshul// cu gang li shi so ma ra// dkar nag spos dang 'bras bu gsum// mtshal dkar rgya mtshal rgyal nyung bdun// tig ta hong len ba sha ka /bong dkar sle tres ba le ka| |gla phur ru rta bse yab dang*// sran ma me tog pri yang ku// ind+ra pā ṇi dbang po lag pa dmag mir bsdus// rwa can sdig pa dkar nag bshan par bcas// sdom brgyad dri chus 'dam btags byas// bra ril tsam bsgril chu bskol gyis// phul la gung gnyis gtang bar bya// gal te rlung shas che ba yis// stod 'phyug ro stod na ba na// a ga ru nag spos dkar bsnan| |gnyan shas che na bya khyung lnga// gshog drug rgyas pas de dag 'joms// yang na khyung lnga 'dre 'jigs dang*// dkar nag sdig pa gur gum dang*// mon gyi dpa' bo sbyar bas 'joms| |yang gcig 'bam rigs gsum ga la// nyung sbyor snying thig man ngag ni// rgyal po nag po zho gang la// dpa' bo gtum po cha phyed de// gu gul gla rtsi shu dag nag

/dpa' bo dang mnyam zho dang sbyar// bra ril tsam bsgril tshad ldan bsten// man ngag snying las gces 'di ko// kun kyang nad tshabs dang bstun zhing*// rig mda'i sbyor bas rtag tu bsnun// bzhi pa rjes gcod rnam pa gnyis// nad ro sbyang dang rjes bcad pa'o// dang po sman gyis nad 'go chog nas// rtsa chu skrangs por bcas pa rnams// cung zad bde ba'i nyams byung tshe// tri byid dang ni brag ban ti// 'brug sgra zab lag gla khul spos// sro thal mon gyi dpa' bo dang*// rgya tshwa sbyar ba'i ril bu ni// sran phos tsam dril grangs ldan pa| |chu bskol phul sogs lto sbyor ltar// byas pas nad ro thon par nges// de rjes skrang po g.ya' zhing za// sbun long shul phyis lcags g.ya' bsnams// yang na shu thor za 'phrug 'byung*| |de kun nad ni smin pa'i rtags// gsang ba sman gyi tshod 'dzin pa// sna gdams li sder chus dril ba// gsal por mthong ba'i dus bab tshe// la nar ta gtub snyim gsum tsam| |rtsi bcud gsar pa cung zad bcas// chu gtsang gis bran rdza snod ni// kha rub nang bcug kha bcad de// nad pas dri ma ma tshor btso// rlung dus bab tshe la nar ta// ma nyams ljang pa smin pa yi// nad pas ma mthong thog byas nas// sman pa 'phags pa seng ge sgra// g.yas pa kha ṭwāṃ sbrul 'khril thogs// g.yon pa klu shing yal ga 'phyang*// 'phrog byed bzhon pa'i skur bsgoms nas// ngag tu 'di skad brjod par bya// oṃ āḥhrī singha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa// sngo sman ral gri reg gcod kyis// 'bam gyi grong khyer 'joms par byed// g.yu lo 'bar ba'i lcags song gi// 'bam nag gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// de skad brjod cing dwangs stabs su// skrang por brag cing 'phur bar bya// la nar ta phur ro ma rnams// glud bcas rgya lam bzhi mdor bskyal// de rjes zhag gsum btsong thang gtang*// chu sngo skrang zhi rtsa 'joms na// 'phrod pa'i rtags yin thug pa la// sbyar bas bco lnga'i zhag grangs bsten// 'bam rigs dkar nag khra bo la// btsong thang btang bas sman 'phro bcad// nag por btsong sman spel gyin gtang*// la nar ta yi thang btang nas// gnyis gsum zhag nas dal gyis 'phye// de nas rim gyis brel bar 'chag

/slar yang bdun dgu'i zhag grangs su// kha 'dzem de nas cha yis glod// gnyen po ji srid bsten bar ru// nad pa sdod yul rlan gsher dang*// gyen thur 'gro dang drag shul dang*// ljid 'gel rkang bzhi zhon 'bab dang*// bza' btung mar tshwa mngar skyur rigs// zhib thud skyur dang ser po'i ja// nyin phyed gnyid rnams spang ba gnad// rjes su nad khrag dbyung ba ni// chu ba 'khum la byin gzhug dang*// brla nang sbal pa na ba la// long rtsa gtar zhing brla yi phyi// na na chu ser gtong rtsa gtar// ngar gdong na la yob gong sogs// rig mda'i sbyor bas nad khrag 'byin// dus la ma bab dpyad bgyis pas// tshe srog 'phrog par byed pa yin// sman pa de ga dmyal bar 'phye| |rkang nad phyi rjes gcod pa yi// byug pa nad bdag gting 'don ni// rus chen gsum gyi 'phrul thal la// g.ya' sngon bsregs pa'i thal bar bcas// bzhi snyoms ngar 'dogs gu gul dang*// dom brun cung zad gcig bsres la// rta rkang 'bru mar rnying pa ni// gang rung dang sbyar skrangs sar byug /dang po gtub cing bar du snyoms// tha mar mdog 'gyur byugs la bstim// nyi mas bsreg pa yang yang bya// des ni nad phyis mi ldang ba// dam pa'i gnad yin e ma mtshar// kye ma 'gro gang 'bam nad kyis// gtses la sman pa 'chi bdag 'gas| |ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul ba yis// srog gi bskul ma byed mthong nas// 'bam bcos legs bshad sna tshogs dang*// mkhas pa'i myong ba mang rtogs pa// legs bshad 'di ko ngas bshad kyi// sman gyi gtso bo 'ga' zhig la// slob dpon zhal gyi gdams pa gces// de ltar lus can la la zhig /'bam gyis gtses pa'i rgyu dag gis// 'chi bdag kha yi g.yang sa ru// ltung bar nye la legs bshad kyi// lcags kyu 'di yis drang bar nges// 'di yi dge ba'ang rdzogs byang nyid// 'thob phyir bsngo yi gzhan du min// de ltar 'bam bcos zab mo tshe 'dzin srog skyob ces bya ba 'di'ang*/

'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las gnas lnga smra ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa don gyi sman pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal pa'i sdes/ sa 'brug zla ba bdun pa'i dmar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i dus dge bar dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen po dang nye ba'i sa'i thig le sngo yug sgang du mgyogs par sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu//
